description: Analyzes the current context window's live health and provides optimization recommendations (HEALTHY/MONITOR/WARNING/CRITICAL), manually triggered.

evals.name: Direct live-window health question
evals.prompt: how full is my context right now
evals.expected_output: Asks the user to run /context and share the output (the reliable source for the HEALTHY/MONITOR/WARNING/CRITICAL assessment), falling back to indirect estimation only if /context output isn't available. Produces a Context Window Analysis report following the template in references/context-window-examples.md (Estimated Status, Observable Indicators, Assessment, Recommendations), using the real 40/80/90 thresholds aligned with context-monitor.py.

evals.name: Broader footprint audit request (should defer to context-audit)
evals.prompt: audit my skills and CLAUDE.md for context bloat
evals.expected_output: Does NOT produce a live-context-window health report. This request is explicitly out of scope per the skill's own 'When NOT to Use' section -- a broader skills/CLAUDE.md/plugin/MCP footprint audit belongs to context-audit instead. The response should point at context-audit (or a comparable footprint-auditing capability) rather than attempting the live-window health check this skill actually does.
